visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair sits at a light-colored wooden table in a well-lit home setting. He wears a light blue patterned polo shirt. An adult's hand enters from the bottom left, gently stroking his face and cheek as he looks directly into the lens. The background features thick grey vertical curtains and a small white electric fan. (2) The camera moves closer to the boy's face in a medium close-up as he responds to off-screen questions. He gestures frequently with his small hands, occasionally pointing upward or resting his head on his palm. His expressions range from thoughtful to sleepy, with visible blinking and occasional shy smiles while he speaks. (3) The boy holds a small, light blue circular hand mirror or toy, turning it carefully in his fingers while looking around. Various graphic overlays, including circular portraits of a man and woman and bold yellow traditional Chinese variety-show text, appear around his head. The lighting remains bright, warm, and consistent. (4) In a wider medium shot, the boy sits with his legs tucked up on the beige chair. He continues talking animatedly, his mouth moving rapidly as he describes his family. He uses the blue object to mimic various actions mentioned in his speech. The camera maintains a steady eye-level perspective throughout this phase. (5) The boy interacts more directly with the interviewer's hand, which occasionally touches his head. He looks up and to the side thoughtfully before leaning toward the table. Colorful emojis and text bubbles continue to pop up, highlighting key words until the video ends with him looking tired and content.
